title: Number of Ways to Reorder Array to Get Same BST
summary: Given an array representing a permutation of integers from 1 to n, find the number of ways to reorder the array so that constructing a BST by inserting elements in order results in a tree identical to the BST formed from the original array.
statement: Given an array representing a permutation of integers from 1 to n, find the number of ways to reorder the array so that constructing a BST by inserting elements in order results in a tree identical to the BST formed from the original array. Return the count modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: nums is a permutation; insert it into a BST in order.
Count other reorderings that create the identical BST, excluding the original ordering, modulo 1,000,000,007.
reference_solution:
def same_bst_reorder_count(nums):
 from math import comb
 def count(values):
  if len(values)<3:return 1
  left=[v for v in values[1:] if v<values[0]];right=[v for v in values[1:] if v>values[0]]
  return comb(len(left)+len(right),len(left))*count(left)*count(right)%1000000007
 return (count(nums)-1)%1000000007
